subject: SeedScale POC — night-window safety pool top-up request
messages:
From: Samuel Park <samuel.park@seedscale.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Night-window safety pool for POC load — urgent ask

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Quick note from the SeedScale infra team: we’re ramping our POC to a 24h night-window run next week to validate p95 latency under sustained 5k rps. Our procurement/legal side has already signed the SOW, but the trial quota in the console is going to be exhausted during the overnight soak.

Can Redwood provision a short-term safety pool (about $3k of credits or equivalent headroom) scoped strictly for the 12:00–06:00 UTC window on 2028-04-18–04-19 so we can complete the load sweep? We’ll share the stress plan and telemetry hooks. This is time-sensitive because the test is gating our internal milestone.

If you need a quick mutual action plan, happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Thanks —
Sam
Samuel Park
Head of Platform
SeedScale

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@seedscale.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night-window safety pool for POC load — urgent ask

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up. Helping SeedScale get the soak done is a priority.

Ben — can we do a provisional credit top-up scoped to the night window Sam called out? Please confirm the amount you can authorize from promo allowance and any operational caveats (start/end times, per-minute throttles, or model restrictions).

Vivek / Ops (Laura) — technical check: are there any concurrency or region routing constraints for a 5k rps overnight run in us-west-2? We should also confirm KV cache behavior and whether we want to pin a model instance for the run to avoid cold starts.

Sam — if you can attach the nightload plan and a short list of endpoints + expected token distribution we’ll map that to the credit provisioning.

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@seedscale.ai>, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night-window safety pool for POC load — provisional top-up

Sam — appreciate the advance notice. We can provision a provisional $3,000 sandbox top-up scoped to 2028-04-18 12:00 UTC through 2028-04-19 06:00 UTC. Terms: credits only usable against the test endpoints you provide, non-transferable, and will be automatically revoked after the window.

I’ve attached a short proposal (proposal_v2.pdf) and the expected test matrix template (nightload-plan.xlsx) — please fill the template and return it by EOD Monday so Ops can finalize.

Operational notes for the team:
- Laura: please reserve a dedicated endpoint (pinned model instance) in us-west-2 for the window to avoid cross-tenant cold starts.
- Vivek: any suggestions on batching/quantization profile to reduce p99 spikes?

Sam — if procurement needs a DocuSign addendum for the credit window I can put together a short form.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments:
- proposal_v2.pdf (PDF, 98 KB)
- nightload-plan.xlsx (Excel, 34 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Park <samuel.park@seedscale.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night-window safety pool for POC load — technical confirmation

Hi all — quick technical confirmation before we lock the window.

- us-west-2 has capacity; we recommend pinning a single model replica of the open-llm-7B-q8a variant for the 12:00–06:00 UTC window. That gives consistent latency and keeps GPU scheduling deterministic.
- For sustained 5k rps, configure batching to 16–32 tokens with the slow-path disabled and enable prefix KV caching. This reduces per-token GPU churn and keeps p99 bounded.
- Add a fallback policy: if average token latency > 450ms for 60s, route to a smaller quantized variant to keep throughput. We can implement routing rules in the console.

Laura — I’ve put a hold on the instance for April 18 11:30–06:30 UTC (provision buffer). Naomi / Ben — once procurement confirms the brief addendum I’ll sign off and we’ll flip the top-up in the console.

Sam — glad we could help; let me know if you want a quick runbook (I can paste into the Drive doc).

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
